description: Spec v1.0 name for run_payments: prepares each payment (payee validation, route assessment, instruction, approval digest) and returns each payment's lifecycle state. Never approves or sends. Same arguments as run_payments; sample: true for the synthetic run.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

file.description: Instead of payables: a payout CSV or pain.001 text.

payables.description: [{ reference, payee: { name, iban?, bic?, account_number?, routing_number?, branch_code?, country? }, amount, currency, due_date?, rail?: bank | provider | stablecoin, via?, wallet? }]

sample.description: true: the built-in sample run (synthetic, labelled), no key needed.

source_currency.description: The currency the business pays from, e.g. ZAR.

name: prepare_payment_instruction
title: Prepare payment instructions
